svg.data-cluster-capacity: 14.4 Tbps standalone, up to 691.2 Tbps in a DDC cluster
svg.data-tcam: Broadcom OP2 BCM16K external TCAM (premium SKU only)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400GE QSFP-DD OpenZR+/ZR/ER4/LR4/FR4/SR8/DR4/DR4+/PLR4; 200GE QSFP56 SR4/FR4; 100GE QSFP28 ZR4/ER4/SR4/LR4 (datasheet Compatible Transceivers). 4x100G break-out is supported on the service ports
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10GE SFP+ on the two management uplinks (datasheet Physical section, '2 x 10G SFP+ management ports'; the Compatible Transceivers list covers only the QSFP-DD field, so no reach or media types are published for these two)
svg.data-fabric-cables: 400GE QSFP-DD AEC, DAC, ACC and AOC on the forty fabric ports (datasheet Compatible Fabric Cable Types); in standalone mode HIG section 4 requires a loopback module in every fabric port so the two J2C+ ASICs stay linked
svg.data-zr-ports: OpenZR+ and ZR are supported on the service ports HIG Figure 10a highlights in brown - 00, 02, 03, 04, 05, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, 21, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31 and 34. That is 22 of the 36 and it is read off the figure, which is the only place the restriction appears: the datasheet says only '36 x 40/100/200/400G QSFP-DD service ports with 400G ZR/ZR+ support' without naming which
svg.data-op2-option-ports: when the premium OP2 external TCAM is enabled, four service ports are taken for statistics and stop forwarding, leaving 32 - HIG Figure 10b/8b highlights them in yellow as ports 01, 17, 19 and 35
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO; SyncE; IEEE 1588v2 (default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2); SMPTE ST 2059-2 (extra licence); T-BC/OC, T-TC
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 and micro-USB, both labelled IOIO, 115200 8N1 (micro-USB needs the Silicon Labs CP210x driver)
svg.data-timing-inputs: 1x 1PPS in/out SMB and 1x 10MHz in/out SMB, both premium-build only, 50 ohm, cable no longer than 3 m
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A; MTCTE; Anatel
